text:
Lena: Quick thread to align on 'grace unification' + a pin-decay orchestration we sketched. Goal: simplify 30d/90d tiers into a single 60d default and offer an automated pin-decay path for low-touch tenants. Want to decide if this is safe to scope to cohort-B next sprint.

Omar: Runtime note: automating decay is feasible but we need deterministic heuristics to avoid accidental cold-start regressions. Propose gating by 1) token usage < 250k/month AND 2) stable QA pass rate for 30d.

Chloe: SRE/ops concerns: any automatic version change is risky. Need per-tenant tracing, traffic shadowing during canary, and an immediate rollback switch. Also add an alert if failure-rate or 99p latency increases >10%.

Amanda: Product: launch criteria draft - (A) canary bench delta <= 2.5% for prioritized prompt slices, (B) rollback < 10min with automated switch, (C) comm templates + opt-out UI, (D) pricing impact documented for reserved contracts. I can own the comm + acceptance checklist.

Maya: Legal/compliance quick: enterprise contracts often mention "pinned versions" explicitly. Need exceptions workflow + legal-approved language for automatic decay and a manual opt-out flag. SMBs can be auto-enrolled after clear notice.

Raj: Implementation sketch: feature-flagged 'pin_decay' controller + background job that evaluates tenants daily. Canary plan: 4 internal tenants + 2 low-traffic customers, 14-day shadowing, then 7-day live canary.

Sample canary config (pseudo) we agreed in meeting:
```json
{
  "pin_decay": "enabled",
  "grace_days_default": "60",
  "usage_token_threshold_month": "250000",
  "min_retention_days": "21",
  "canary_tenants": ["int-team-a","int-team-b","cust-light-42"],
  "shadow_mode_days": "14",
  "live_canary_days": "7",
  "rollback_sla_minutes": "10"
}
```

Chloe: +1. Add line to capture sample outputs (store a small corpus of inputs/outputs pre/post change) for offline diffing and regression alerts. Also: ensure KV cache priming script runs after decay for a week to avoid token regen storms.

Amanda: Acceptance gates addition: product needs a report comparing pinned vs decayed across top-8 customer prompt slices and signed-off comm templates. Also confirm billing: decayed tenants should not be charged pinned-reserved rates unless contract says so.

Lena: Action items recap: Raj -> implement feature-flag + simulation harness (owner: Raj, due Thu EOD); Chloe -> add alerts + priming script + trace hooks (owner: Chloe, due Fri); Amanda -> draft comm + benchmark checklist (owner: Amanda, due Mon); Maya -> pull list of contract exceptions and legal wording (owner: Maya, due Mon). I'll schedule a 20m review the Tue after canary starts.

ops-bot: CI pipeline: feature/pin-decay -> staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T02:00Z (dry-run).

Lena: Thanks — if anyone sees showstoppers call me out. :thumbsup:
